summary:
Citrix VDI: type with a codeBlock calling pydirectinput, not keyPress (it doubles keys). No Ctrl shortcuts reach it.
keepAlive.ps1 sends Esc about every 60 s: dismisses menus and dialogs mid-step.
body:
## Typing into the Citrix VDI

keyboardAction keyPress doubles characters through Citrix. A codeBlock that calls pydirectinput.press per character works.
